reviewSamples.author: Le set Café Bakery (dueña/Local Guide, foto propia del negocio)
reviewSamples.text: The best place to buy your Haitian foods and baked goods. The service is fast, friendly and their foods taste really good. They also serve hot tea, coffee, hot chocolate and homemade juices.

reviewSamples.author: Oxx Beekeeping
reviewSamples.text: Beautiful atmosphere. Great customer service. Delicious food. Tried the fish patty and the fried snapper with the black rice and a side of black beans and salad. Everything was delicious. The sweets look good too. I like that they had some of the desert samples out to try.

reviewSamples.author: Lissa Valsaint
reviewSamples.text: First off this is one of the best cafe that I have ever been to. Found this by accident and I’m soo happy I did!!! The owner and cook are soo nice and accommodating as we couldn’t decide what we wanted (too many great options lol) The food …

reviewSamples.author: Maureen CF01ORANGE
reviewSamples.text: Omg! The customer service is top notch! Paties delicious. I also had the Akra. Very good. My new favorite spot

reviewSamples.author: samarra sam
reviewSamples.text: I love Le Set Cafe! This is truly authentic Haitian food. Every time I order, the food is consistently delicious. Now Customer Service is 10/10!! Upon walking into the store, I am always greeted with a smile, the environment is extremely welcoming. Everything is done in a timely matter.

services_research: No hay carta de precios publicada (sin website, sin booking, sin IG/FB localizados para esta ubicacion). Items reales mencionados en reseñas y confirmados por las fotos propias del negocio (Google Maps, etiquetadas por la dueña como Local Guide con 161 fotos en esta ficha): patties/paties (empanada haitiana), Akra (fritter de malanga/taro), fried snapper con black rice (diri djon djon) y side de black beans y salad, pineapple upside-down cakes, muffins, fresh juices (mango, pineapple-ginger, pineapple-mango fruit ice), hot tea/ginger tea, coffee, hot chocolate, homemade juices, dessert samples en mostrador. Sin precios publicados en ninguna fuente: se usa 'se cotiza, escribenos / ask in store' para los items, nombrando los reales encontrados, nunca inventando montos.
fotos_nota: 12 fotos reales descargadas de la ficha de Google Maps (place_id ChIJ_621IAB754gR2271VFQfb8c): 3 del listado principal de fotos del negocio (hero + 2 del carrusel) y 9 extraidas abriendo las fotos adjuntas a reseñas reales (la propia dueña del negocio como Local Guide: 'Rice, beans, and meat platter', 'Pineapple upside-down cakes and muffins', 'Fresh mango juice with slices', 'Fresh pineapple and ginger juice', 'Pineapple and mango fruit ice'; mas 2 fotos del cliente Oxx Beekeeping y 3 fotos del cliente Lissa Valsaint, estas ultimas del mostrador/interior). Contact sheet revisado visualmente (output/le-set-cafe-bakery/_sheet.jpg): todas son fotos reales de comida, bebidas e interior del local, sin selfies, sin texto superpuesto, sin blur ni clutter. Ninguna foto de stock. 8 seleccionadas para hero/galeria/about: gmaps-4 (hero, flatlay de comida con decoracion floral), gmaps-1, gmaps-9 (platos de pescado frito con black rice/paties), gmaps-5 (pasteles/pineapple upside-down cake), gmaps-6, gmaps-2 (jugos frescos), gmaps-3, gmaps-10 (interior/mostrador con lamparas de ratan y vitrinas de bebidas).
